eggbun-revanced.description: Eggbun Morphe builds upon the original Eggbun app, a fun Korean language learning tool that uses a chatbot tutor named Lanny for interactive practice in speaking, reading, listening, and writing skills. This modification applies custom patches from the hoo-dles repository to the package kr.eggbun.eggconvo, primarily 'Enable Premium' to bypass subscription barriers and unlock full access to all courses, advanced lessons, personalized word lists, quizzes, and ebooks without monthly or yearly fees. It also includes 'Force native keyboard' for improved typing, with broad compatibility across versions, making it ideal for beginners seeking premium features for free.
